requirements.statement: Remove the normal v1 mission runtime, mission-v2 compatibility product path, topology router, duplicate repository-map and developer-UX wrappers, and temporary upgrade kernel after all active consumers use ChangeGraph, FactGraph, EvidencePlanner, RuntimeProfile, canonical ledger, and kernel CLI semantics.

Retain deterministic, fail-closed historical v1 ledger migration through a narrow versioned reader and minimal frozen fixtures, preserving source bytes, digests, unknown fields, absence, and explicit uncertainty without inventing grants or evidence.

Move useful feedback and entropy inspection out of kernel core into explicitly optional maintenance tooling and move generic target-project frontend, reliability, security, and release guidance into an explicit policy-pack/template location.

Replace .control-plane as an active runtime namespace with canonical .keel distribution metadata, archive bootstrap research away from product authority, and remove reconciled planning residue, stale verification configuration, obsolete phase-agent configuration, and obsolete architecture documentation.

Preserve candidate and landed refs, Git notes indexing, candidate/landed attestations, exact committed-tree verification, worktree isolation, repository-relative normalization, fail-closed malformed-state handling, explicit uncertainty, and generic explorer/reviewer/risk-reviewer capabilities.

Prove retirement safety by repository reference search, deterministic tests, migration round-trip and idempotence, CLI behavior, documentation validation, runtime entry-point inspection, and a mechanical no-dual-path regression check.
Update the active architecture and governance documentation to describe one canonical architecture, one semantic vocabulary, one normal CLI, and no dual v1/v2 product path.
